red__getalignment.pro


Routines

top source red::getalignment

CRISP pipeline

red::getalignment, align=align [, prefilters=strarr] [, extraclip=intarr(4)] [, cams=strarr] [, refcam=integer], makeoffsets=makeoffsets [, output_dir=string] [, /overwrite]

Calculate align-clip and offset files for an arbitrary subset of cameras and states.

Keywords

align out

Array of structures containing clip, offset filenames and state information.

prefilters in optional type=strarr

Indicate the prefilters to calculate the clips/offsets for. Default is to do it for all prefilters.

extraclip in optional type=intarr(4)

Exclude a margin around the clip-area

cams in optional type=strarr

Indicate the cameras to calculate the clips/offsets for. Default is to do it for all cameras.

refcam in optional type=integer default=0

Select reference camera

makeoffsets
output_dir in optional type=string default=self.out_dir+'/calib/'

The directory in which to write offset files.

overwrite in optional type=boolean default=false

Force re-calculation if files already exist.

Author information
